title: 第一卷 风起时 第七章 谢禾割首第一卷 风起时 第八章 传说中的鱼
content_zh:
;;
虽然大鼎村这边只有三人，陈风奇那边却有四人。
但无论是中年男女，还是青年，心中都没有丝毫畏惧。
之前陈风奇几人对付异兽的一幕，他们都看在眼里。
陈航、谢禾、杜小康三人为了牵制异兽，可谓竭尽全力，极大程度损耗了修为，战力必然会大打折扣。
尤其是杜小康，几乎到了力竭的程度，好几次都险些支撑不住，已经不能算作战力。
反观自己这边，可都是全盛状态。
真正能值得他们在意的，也就只有当时出力最少的陈风奇。
可也只是在意而已，大家都是凝气三层，谁还能怕了谁？
中年男子的速度最快，眼中闪烁着狠厉光芒，瞬间已至陈风奇近前。
“正合我意！”
陈风奇低喝一声，不退反进，同样迎了上去。
先前他本就给过陈航几人眼神示意，已经随时准备松开束缚异兽的长鞭，去放手一搏。
如今异兽被突如其来的邋遢女带走，反倒让他省去了一个顾虑。
并且，不止是大鼎村三人怕邋遢女会再回来，陈风奇也怕。
他心中想的，同样是速战速决。
故而他没有任何保留，在前冲的同时，直接就施展出了鬼雾异术。
当薄薄的一层黑雾逸散，笼罩周身时，陈风奇只觉整个人立时变得无比轻盈。
他此刻身体逸散的黑雾，相比半月前刚学会鬼雾异术的时候，明显要浓郁许多。
那种飘然若升之感，也更为强烈，让他的速度在陡然间，暴增了近乎两倍。

这就是他这半个月下来的修行成果。
在鬼雾异术的加持下，他宛如化作了一道魅影。
中年男子只觉眼前一花，陈风奇已经出现在他的面前，同时挥刀斩落。
“异术！”
男子顿时大惊。
可因为陈风奇的速度实在太快，即便他有所反应，也已经来不及闪躲，只能横刀格挡。
伴随着“叮”一声脆响，两人手中的黑鼎碎片完成了一次激烈碰撞。
中年男子紧握碎片的大手，都在这次碰撞中被震得微微发麻，整个人更是不受控制向后倒退了两步。
反观陈风奇，跟没事人一样，几乎没有停顿，再次欺身而上。
尽管在修行天赋方面，陈风奇不太行。
可迄今为止，他已经吃过两株宝药，肉身在经过了药力的不断强化后，比之其他纯靠修行的同境界者，还要更强一些。
此乃宝药的特性，不但能够提升修为，还能强大血肉筋骨，极大程度增长肉身力量。
实际上，中年男子也吃过宝药，但却只吃过小半株。
从陈风奇这两次外出探索的经历，就不难看出，想要得到一株宝药，其实很难。
一来，宝药本就罕见，寻找十分不易。
即便运气好遇上了，不仅要对付异兽，还可能要与其他避风村的人进行争夺。
哪怕最弱小的异兽，也不是凝气三层修士能轻易应付的。
而与其他避风村的人争夺，更是凶险难测。
稍有不慎，就会命丧当场。
大鼎村的这三人，多次外出探索，也只成功得到过一株氤氲三尺灵光的宝药。

尤其是，那宝药最后还被一分为三，以至于每个人所能得到的提升都很有限。
相比之下，吞服过两株完整宝药的陈风奇，给他肉身带来的变化，是相当大的。

Although there are only three people on Dading Village's side, there are four on Chen Fengqi's side.
But no matter whether they are middle-aged men, women or young people, they have no fear in their hearts.
They all saw the scene where Chen Fengqi and others dealt with the strange beasts.
Chen Hang, Xie He, and Du Xiaokang tried their best to contain the alien beasts, which greatly damaged their cultivation, and their combat power was bound to be greatly reduced.
Du Xiaokang, in particular, was almost at the point of exhaustion. He almost couldn't hold on several times and could no longer be considered a combat effectiveness.
On the other hand, everything on my side is in full swing.
The only person they really cared about was Chen Fengqi, who contributed the least at that time.
But that's all I care about. Everyone is at the third level of Qi Condensation. Who can be afraid of whom?
The middle-aged man was the fastest, with a fierce light in his eyes, and he was in front of Chen Fengqi in an instant.
"Just what I wanted!"
Chen Fengqi gave a low shout, advanced instead of retreating, and also faced him.
He had given Chen Hang and others a look before, and was ready to loosen the long whip restraining the alien beast at any time and give it a try.
Now that the strange beast was taken away by the unexpected sloppy girl, it saved him a worry.
Moreover, not only the three people in Dading Village were afraid that the sloppy girl would come back again, but Chen Fengqi was also afraid.
What he had in mind was also a quick victory.
Therefore, he did not hold anything back. While charging forward, he directly used the Ghost Mist Technique.
When a thin layer of black mist dissipated and enveloped his whole body, Chen Fengqi felt that his whole body immediately became extremely light.
The black mist escaping from his body at this moment was obviously much thicker than when he first learned the ghost mist technique half a month ago.
The feeling of soaring was even more intense, causing his speed to nearly triple in a sudden.
This is the result of his practice in the past half month.
With the blessing of ghost mist magic, he seemed to have turned into a phantom.
The middle-aged man's eyes only dimmed as Chen Fengqi appeared in front of him and slashed him with his sword.
"Exotic magic!"
The man was suddenly shocked.
But because Chen Fengqi was so fast, even if he reacted, he would have no time to dodge and could only block with his sword.
With a crisp "ding" sound, the black cauldron fragments in the hands of the two people completed a fierce collision.
The middle-aged man's big hands holding the fragments were slightly numb from the shock, and he took two steps backward uncontrollably.
On the other hand, Chen Fengqi, like a normal person, barely paused and bullied him again.
Although in terms of cultivation talent, Chen Fengqi is not very good.
But so far, he has taken two precious medicines, and after the continuous strengthening of the medicine's power, his physical body is stronger than other people in the same realm who rely solely on cultivation.
This is the characteristic of the treasure medicine. It can not only improve the cultivation level, but also strengthen the flesh, blood, muscles and bones, greatly increasing the physical strength.
In fact, middle-aged men have also taken medicinal herbs, but only half of the plant.
From Chen Fengqi's two exploration experiences, it is not difficult to see that it is actually very difficult to obtain a precious medicine.
First of all, the precious medicine is rare and difficult to find.
Even if you are lucky, you will not only have to deal with strange beasts, but you may also have to compete with people from other shelter villages.
Even the weakest alien beast is not something that a third-level Qi Condensation monk can easily deal with.
And competing with people from other shelter villages is even more dangerous and unpredictable.
If you are not careful, you will die on the spot.
The three people from Dading Village have gone out to explore many times, but they have only succeeded in obtaining a precious medicine with three feet of dense light.
In particular, the precious medicine was finally divided into three parts, so that the improvement that everyone could get was very limited.
In comparison, Chen Fengqi, who had swallowed two complete medicinal herbs, had considerable changes in his physical body.
